messages:
tara: Quickstart users reporting a waterfall of 429s when running mixed embed+gen jobs. Root cause looks like combined effects: high default parallelism + auth refresh thundering + paginator requeue ignoring Retry-After.

ben: Which SDK?

tara: Node quickstart. Repro: start bulk job, hit a token refresh, dozens of requests get 401 then immediately retry, then quota collapses.

ezra: Two quick mitigations: single-flight auth refresh, and make paginator pause for Retry-After instead of immediate requeue. Also drop default parallelPages to 3 for quickstart.

ben: Agreed. Also file parity issue: Python has per-route limits; Node only global. I'll open SDK issue proposing per-route config like `rateLimit.route('/embeds',{maxInFlight:4,windowMs:1000})`.

tara: I'll PR quickstart: reduce default, add honorRetryAfter flag, and enable auth single-flight for demo. Add a short docs blurb under /docs/inference/rate-limits about client-side throttling patterns.

sdk-bot: CI queued for branch fix/quickstart-rate-smoothing (#1210)

ezra: Also add an e2e that simulates 401 then 429+Retry-After to prevent regressions.

ben: Thanks — should cut onboarding tickets significantly.
